ENGR 1014.title: Engineering Research Seminar
ENGR 1014.description: An undergraduate-level seminar designed for students who are interested in learning more about ongoing research and graduate education opportunities across the Virginia Tech College of Engineering. Credit earned for this course may not be used to satisfy degree requirements.

ENGR 1034.title: Hypatia First-Year Seminar
ENGR 1034.description: A first‑year seminar for students in the Hypatia Living Learning Community, focused on community building, community or service activities, and core skills for success in engineering. Highlights key campus resources, professional development, and community building within an engineering‑themed residence hall. Credit earned for this course may not be used to satisfy degree requirements.
ENGR 1034.coreq: Living in the Galileo and Hypatia Living Learning Program

ENGR 1054.title: Galileo First-Year Seminar
ENGR 1054.description: A first‑year seminar for students in the Galileo Living Learning Community, focused on community building, community or service activities, and core skills for success in engineering. Highlights key campus resources, professional development, and community building within an engineering‑themed residence hall. Credit earned for this course may not be used to satisfy degree requirements.
ENGR 1054.coreq: Living in the Galileo and Hypatia Living Learning Program

ENGR 1074.title: Galileo and Hypatia First-Year Seminar
ENGR 1074.description: A first-year, second‑semester seminar for students in the Galileo and Hypatia Living‑Learning Community. This course builds on the fall seminars (ENGR 1034 and 1054) by guiding students through structured assignments and community or service activities that help them develop greater independence and reflection in their learning. Credit earned for this course may not be used to satisfy degree requirements.
ENGR 1074.coreq: Living in the Galileo and Hypatia Living Learning Program

ENGR 2004A.title: Engineering International Activity
ENGR 2004A.description: Engineering International Education course reflects academic effort in study abroad settings as defined by the college. No degree applicable credit awarded. Enrollment in this course does not apply toward the definition of full time status. 0 Credits.

ENGR 2004E.title: Engineering Experiential Learning
ENGR 2004E.description: Engineering Experiential course reflects college defined experiential learning experiences for undergraduates. No degree applicable credit is awarded. Enrollment in this course does not apply toward the definition of full time status.

ENGR 2004R.title: Engineering Undergraduate Exploratory Activity
ENGR 2004R.description: Engineering Undergraduate Exploratory Activity course is an undergraduate research experience as defined by the college. No degree applicable credit is awarded. Enrollment in this course will not apply toward the definition of full time status. 0 Credits.

ENGR 2004S.title: Engineering Service Learning
ENGR 2004S.description: Engineering Service Learning course reflects academic effort in service learning settings as defined by the college. No degree applicable credit is awarded. Enrollment in this course will not apply toward the definition of full time status. 0 Credits.

ENGR 2044.title: Second-Year Galileo and Hypatia Seminar
ENGR 2044.description: Second-Year Galileo and Hypatia seminar for student leaders. Success strategies designed for second-year engineering students who are participants of the Galileo and Hypatia Living-Learning Community; topics include communication skills, critical thinking skills, diversity, leadership, networking with peers and future employers, and goals associated with academic and professional success.

ENGR 3044.title: Third-Year Galileo and Hypatia Seminar
ENGR 3044.description: Success strategies designed for third year engineering students who are participants of the Galileo and Hypatia Living-Learning Community; topics include critical thinking skills, diversity, leadership, networking with peers and future employers, and goals associated with academic and professional success.

ENGR 3124.title: Introduction to Green Engineering
ENGR 3124.description: Introduction to green engineering and global environmental issues. Impacts of human and engineering activities on the environment, and techniques that can be utilized to minimize adverse environmental impacts with emphasis on environmentally conscious design and manufacturing.

ENGR 4134.title: Environmental Life Cycle Assessment
ENGR 4134.description: Quantification of the environmental impacts for products, processes, and systems across all engineering disciplines. A detailed look at life cycle phases and formal and informal Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodologies including ISO standards, stream-lined LCA, green building ratings systems, carbon footprints, and other environmental ratings systems.

ENGR 5204.title: Projects and the Systems Engineering Process
ENGR 5204.description: A cap-stone design experience for systems engineering students; practical exercise progressively applies steps in the systems engineering design process to develop a design solution; includes elements of systems modeling concepts.
